rationale: Despite gapping down 3.81% at the open on elevated 2.88x relative volume, buyers immediately stepped in to push price $4.00 higher in the third minute and establish a tight consolidation well above session VWAP ($213.85). Holding the upper 87.8% of the opening range while the last two 1-minute candles digest gains on declining volume indicates strong absorption and favors continuation toward filling the gap to the prior close ($220.46). Invalidation is placed just below the base of the two-minute consolidation ($215.35) to maintain an asymmetric reward-to-risk ratio.
